patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "tata consultancy services", 2026-10-06

reading.body:
Tata Consultancy Services holds 1,581 granted US patents, and its most recent grants are machine learning methods rather than generic IT services claims.

The five most recent patents, granted between 22 and 29 September 2026, cover explainability of black box models, contextual bandits for e-commerce pricing, autoencoder sensor fusion, knowledge graphs built by multi-agent large language models, and chained neural networks for transit delay prediction. This is applied machine learning work attached to specific operational problems, not foundation model research. The patent record shows a services firm building tooling around models it did not train itself.

For AI scaling, the relevant fact is what is absent. The data contains no data centers, no power contracts, no chip procurement, and no compute figures. A patent portfolio of this kind measures intellectual property output, not the physical capacity to run models. TCS's position in AI depends on where its clients' workloads are hosted, and that is not visible here.

The data also does not cover ungranted applications, non-US filings, or any products built on these patents. The count is limited to grants since 2001 matching the applicant phrase "tata consultancy services," so it undercounts work filed under subsidiary or variant names. Treat the portfolio as a signal of direction, not of scale.

profile_text.body:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an Indian information technology services and consulting company headquartered in Mumbai, part of the Tata Group, operating in 150 locations across 46 countries. As of 2024 Tata Sons owned 71.74 percent of it, and TCS supplied close to 80 percent of Tata Sons' dividend income.

Source: Wikipedia, Tata Consultancy Services, retrieved 22 September 2026.
